limitations: Public URLs, live HTTP response behavior, hosting, production availability, DNS, release permission and IndexNow were not tested or authorized by this QA.

Full-page screenshots show a fixed mobile CTA near the initial viewport bottom; they are not proof that every dynamic scrolled viewport is free of occlusion. No independent interactive real-device scrolling test was performed.

The original native element-level FAQ PNG samples contain sticky-header/fixed-CTA overlays over some text. They alone are not sufficient unclipped-FAQ evidence. The supplemental full-page JPEG sections show the FAQ content without those element-capture overlays.
390px and 1280px captures were directly inspected for layout and image integrity; this does not claim exhaustive character-by-character proofreading of all rendered text at every size.
Native PNG hashes were checked for every file, but actual native PNG pixel inspection covered six samples, not every native PNG.

Original capture-results.json and evidence-manifest.json retain pixelReview:pending because they predate this independent pixel review; this separate review supplies the later verdict without rewriting artifact bytes.
CI browser facts and navigation/back/reload assertions are recorded runner telemetry independently inspected as files, not a second browser execution by this reviewer.
